$comment: What each first-run guide card DEPICTS. When a PR changes one of these files without touching the guide, CI asks whether the card is still true. Keys must match GUIDE_CARDS in cards.ts (a unit test enforces it); paths must exist (scripts/check-guide-drift.mjs enforces it). Ack a PR that changes behaviour the guide doesn't show with a `Guide: reviewed` line in the PR body or a commit message. `pick` depicts nothing: it IS the feature, and its own tests (pickSongs.test.ts) pin what it does.
